items.title: Availability aur nines: 99.9% ka matlab saal mein kitna downtime
items.one_idea: Availability is uptime divided by total time; each extra nine cuts the allowed downtime per year by about 10x (99.9% is about 9 hours, 99.99% about 53 minutes, 99.999% about 5 minutes), and dependencies in a row multiply their availabilities, so the total is lower than any single part.
items.spoken_hook: 99.9% uptime का मतलब: साल में कितनी देर बंद रहेगा?
items.hook_formula: direct_question: the number the viewer has seen on every SLA page, asked as a plain question about it
items.visual_idea: One fixed frame: a long 365-day bar with the allowed downtime cut out as a red sliver; stepping 99%, 99.9%, 99.99%, 99.999% shrinks the sliver each time on a ladder of cards. Then three boxes in a row with their availabilities multiplying into a thicker sliver.
items.everyday_anchor: A UPI payment app or IRCTC booking page being down for a few hours on the day you need it.
